results.title: Schedule | cackalackycon 2026
results.content: With the framework established, the speaker will walk through real-world case studies from their own offensive AI development work: browser-automated web application pentesting, using AI to attack AI systems (featuring two Claude Code command injection vulnerabilities the speaker discovered), threat intelligence and attribution workflows with a peak at bypassing CAPTCHA, and long-running vulnerability research harnesses - including the workflow that led to a $20,000 Microsoft Edge 0day. I'll show live attacks against the defensive layers developers trust to keep LLM-generated code safe: poisoning CLAUDE.md context files to make review agents selectively blind, crafting PRs that manipulate AI code reviewers into approving vulnerabilities, exploiting the trust boundary between human developers and their AI security tools, and using indirect prompt injection to turn CI-integrated LLM agents against the codebase they're protecting. Every attack in this talk runs against open-source repos with real defensive tooling — the same pre-commit hooks, Claude Code review agents, and security scanning workflows that teams are deploying right now.
